ui.settings.about_credits_hint: Open-source software this hub downloads and hands to managed machines.
ui.settings.backup_hint: Holds all of config/. The credentials inside travel sealed under the vault master password, which restoring asks for.
ui.settings.hub_name_apply_hint: Every client that joined shows this hub under the new name.
ui.settings.hub_name_hint: The name clients show this hub as.
ui.settings.language_apply_hint: Draws every page in the chosen language.
ui.settings.language_hint: The language this panel is drawn in.
ui.settings.not_a_backup: This is not a Neutrino backup.
ui.settings.password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions stay signed in.
ui.settings.restore_applying: Applying the restored configuration; this can take minutes when heavy services re-render.
ui.settings.restore_body: Every file under config/ is overwritten by the archive's, the configuration is applied, and the panel restarts on its own.
ui.settings.restore_failed_apply: The apply did not finish; the lines above say why. The files were restored; fix the cause and run it again from a terminal: sudo nhub apply
ui.settings.restore_failed_lost: The panel did not come back on its own. The files were restored; run sudo nhub apply from a terminal, then reload this page.
ui.settings.restore_restarting: The panel is restarting; this page reloads by itself. Sign in with the restored password.
ui.settings.theme_apply_hint: Draws every page in the chosen palette.
ui.settings.theme_hint: The palette this panel is drawn in. System follows the browser's scheme.
ui.settings.title: Settings
ui.settings.update_checkout: This hub runs from a checkout; update it with git.
ui.settings.update_confirm_body: The package is downloaded and checked, then installed by systemd outside the panel. The panel restarts, this page reloads to the sign-in, and the agents on your devices update themselves from the new hub. If {version} does not answer within three minutes, {from} is put back.
ui.settings.update_confirm_no_rollback: No release carries the package of {from}, so nothing can be put back if {version} does not come up; that would need a terminal on the box.
ui.settings.update_failed: The update stopped before the install started; the lines above say why.
ui.settings.update_lost: The panel never came back. On the box, read what happened with: journalctl -u neutrino_hub_update
ui.settings.update_major: {version} is a new major version. A major changes the shape of the configuration, so the upgrade guide carries the box across by hand; this panel does not install it.
ui.settings.update_none_published: No release has been published yet.
ui.settings.update_on_newest: This hub is on the newest release, {version}.
ui.settings.update_reason.disk_space_sho: the disk was short of room
ui.settings.update_reason.health_gate_fa: the new version did not answer within the time allowed
ui.settings.update_reason.package_fetch_: the package could not be downloaded whole
ui.settings.update_reason.package_instal: the package manager refused the package
ui.settings.update_reason.package_sha256: the package did not match its published digest
ui.settings.update_reason.rollback_fetch: the rollback package could not be fetched
ui.settings.update_reason.update_interru: the update stopped before it wrote what became of it
ui.settings.update_reason.update_launch_: systemd would not start the install
ui.settings.update_restarting: The panel is restarting under the new version; this page reloads when it answers.
ui.settings.update_restarting_long: Still waiting. If the new version did not come up, the install is putting the old one back on its own, which takes up to six more minutes.
ui.settings.update_result_failed: The update to {to} failed: {reason}. The box may be on neither version; check it from a terminal.
ui.settings.update_result_rolled_back: {to} did not come up: {reason}. {from} is back.
ui.settings.update_room_short: The update needs {needed} free and the disk has {free}; make room before installing.
ui.settings.vault_password_hint: The master password of the vault this backup was taken from.
ui.settings.wrong_file: Backups are .tar.gz files; that file is not one.
